journey.name: M10 Google-first sign-in with phone OTP
journey.description: Fresh app data; backend reachable, seeded, and running with OTP_DEV_ECHO=true (debug builds show the code under the code field); Google OAuth configured and a Google account on the device. Demo numbers: maya.travels +1 201-555-0101, kai.garden +1 201-555-0106; unseeded test numbers 201-555-0150 and 201-555-0177.

actions.action: Verify that the Welcome screen shows "Continue with Google" as the main action and "Sign in with phone"
Tap "Sign in with phone", enter "2015550150" (United States) and tap "Send code"
Verify that "No account is linked to this number. Sign in with Google to create one." and a "Continue with Google" button are shown
Select "United States" in the country picker, enter "2015550101" and tap "Send code"
Verify that "Enter the code we sent to +1 ••••••0101." and a resend countdown are shown
Enter "000000" and tap "Sign in"; verify "That code isn't right. 4 tries left." is shown
Enter the code shown as "Dev build: the code is …" and tap "Sign in"; verify that the Home feed is shown
Open Profile → "Edit profile"; verify the Phone row shows "+1 201-555-0101"
Tap "Change", select "United States", enter "2015550199", tap "Send code", enter the dev code and tap "Save"; verify the Phone row shows "+1 201-555-0199"
Go back to Profile → "Settings" → "Log out"; verify the Welcome screen is shown
Sign in by phone as kai.garden (+1 201-555-0106) with the dev code
Open Profile → "Settings" → "Delete account" → "Send code", enter the dev code and tap "Delete"; verify the Welcome screen is shown
Sign in by phone with +1 201-555-0106 again; verify "No account is linked to this number" is shown
Tap "Continue with Google", then "Continue with Google" on the Welcome screen and pick the device's Google account

Verify the "Almost done" onboarding screen is prefilled with a suggested username and the Google name; enter "2015550177", tap "Send code", enter the dev code and tap "Create account"; verify the Home feed is shown
Log out, then "Continue with Google" with the same account; verify it signs straight in to the Home feed
